title: Practice
description: Train one skill at a time on the items of {lesson}, or target your weak spots.
empty: There is nothing to practice here right now.

recognition.audioPrompt: Listen to the sound, then choose the matching character.
recognition.visualPrompt: Look at the character, then choose the matching sound.
recognition.noAudio: Audio is not available on this device, so this question shows the character instead.

recall.label: Recall this character's sound without options, then type it in romaji.

sentence.instruction: Arrange the pieces to say the sentence in Japanese.
sentence.empty: Tap the pieces below in order.

feedback.confusedWith: That is the answer for {item}. These two are easy to mix up.
feedback.saveError: Could not save your answer. Please try again.
feedback.audioCorrect: Good. You matched the sound to the right character.
feedback.audioIncorrect: Listen once more and try to remember how the sound and the shape go together.
feedback.confusedWithChosen: You chose {item}. These two are easy to mix up.

writing.compare: Compare your writing with the model. Did you write this character?
writing.instruction: Listen to the sound, then write the matching character in the writing area.
writing.instructionVisual: Read the sound shown, then write the matching character in the writing area.

quality.excellent: Your writing matches the model well.
quality.needs_improvement: The character is correct, but the handwriting can be more precise.
quality.incorrect: Your writing doesn't match {character} yet. Look at the model again, then try once more.

outcome.title: Learning outcome
outcome.notPassed: Not met yet. Aim for {pass} or more.

objectives.review: Recall these items correctly now that they are due, so they move to longer review intervals.
objectives.weak: Correct the items you missed recently.
objectives.assessment: Answer questions on the items you have practiced least. This is a check, not new learning.
objectives.stage: Practice {skill} at the {focus} level until it is reliable.

introduction.title: Meet the characters
introduction.prompt: Each character stands for a sound. Look at it and listen to it before you practice. This is not a test: nothing here is scored.
introduction.noAudio: No Japanese voice was found on this device, so the sounds are shown as text.

exam.conditions: Exam conditions: answers are not shown until the end.
exam.timeUp: Time is up. Questions you did not answer count as wrong.

hub.gymDescription: Train one skill at a time, step by step. This is separate from your course: a skill moves up when you do well and back a step when you struggle.
hub.masteredAll: All available stages passed. Keep them fresh with review.

reason.start: Start here: this is the first stage.
reason.continue: Keep going: more recent evidence is needed on this stage.
reason.advance: You passed the stage before, so this one is next.
reason.regress: Your recent {weak} results were weak, so go back a step to {stage} and then retry.
reason.retry: Your recent results here were weak. Practice this stage again.
reason.mastered: You passed every available stage. They stay fresh through review.

instruction.word: Write this word by hand in the writing area.
instruction.sentence: Write this sentence by hand in the writing area.
instruction.context: Read the situation and write an appropriate reply by hand in the writing area.
instruction.free: Write your own short message by hand in the writing area. The model is only one example.

textWriting.selfNote: The app does not read handwriting. You compare with the model and rate yourself.
textWriting.compare: Compare your writing with the model. How did it go?

comprehension.readInstruction: Read the text, then answer the question.
comprehension.listenInstruction: Listen to the conversation, then answer the question.
comprehension.noAudio: Audio is not available on this device, so the conversation is shown as text.
